meaning:
ἐπ-ανα-παύω
[in LXX, mid., for נוּחַ, שָׁעַן ni ;]
to refresh, cause to rest (upon); mid., to rest upon: metaphorically, with dative, Rom.2:17; before ἐπί, with accusative, Luk.10:6 (Cremer, 827).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,
